name: Al Meera Consumer Goods Company Q.P.S.C.
summary: Al Meera Consumer Goods Company Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale and retail trade of various types of consumer commodities in Qatar and the Sultanate of Oman. The company operates in three segments: Retail, Investment, and Leasing. It is involved in buying and sale of consumer goods; and investment activities, including equity and funds as financial assets through other comprehensive income and fixed deposits. The company also rents out shops in various malls.
